dedupe_keys.name: ribasim simulated water budget for messara river basin in crete baseline and what if climate scenarios

description: The STARS4Water project deposits RIBASIM 8 water-budget results for nine sub-basins of the Messara basin in Crete, Greece. Three public XLSX workbooks cover the 1989 to 2022 reference simulation and stochastic sequences of five and seven consecutive dry years. The own page identifies irrigation and public-supply demand nodes, delivered water, deficits and surplus. A water-allocation modeller can use these results to compare supply reliability under prolonged drought or check a Messara model against published scenario outputs. The drought sequences represent statistical stress tests derived from historical precipitation and potential evapotranspiration, not dated climate forecasts. Zenodo states CC BY 4.0 and public access. Workbook cells and variable units were not opened, so the node mapping and numerical results remain unverified. No catalogue record covers this deposit. Round one rejected it because it was a single-study resource, although the published scenario workbooks meet the current reuse rule.
